environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed on EKS. The ALB ingress annotation specifies `alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/mutual-authentication: '{"port":443,"mode":"verify","trustStore":"arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/internal-ca-bundle/abc123","ignoreClientCertificateExpiry":false}'`. The trust store contains only the organization's internal PKI intermediate CA certificate (CN=InternalServices-ICA-2024). Additionally, the target group health check path validates the service is running but the ALB will RST any TLS handshake where the client does not present a certificate chaining to the specified trust store. The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy on the namespace restricts ingress solely to the ALB security group CIDR (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f/32 mapped via VPC CNI), preventing direct pod access bypassing the load balancer.
